answer: The reveal must open the same garden hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the nectar gate. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 44 original texts is the only way to fill 93 aliases; the trellis log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 6 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
